## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Vipākattika* (Patthana 19.3) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Bibliographically, it treats the triad of karmic resultants (*vipāka-ttika*, or "the triad 'karmically resultant, etc.'"), which constitutes the third triad of the Abhidhamma *mātikā* matrix systematically applied throughout the combinatorial sections of the *Paṭṭhāna* [Nyanatiloka 2007].
